en-US.description: A professional open source system to create Windows installers
en-US.longDescription:
NSIS (Nullsoft Scriptable Install System) is a professional open source system to create Windows installers. It is designed to be as small and flexible as possible and is therefore very suitable for internet distribution.
Being a user's first experience with your product, a stable and reliable installer is an important component of successful software. With NSIS you can create such installers that are capable of doing everything that is needed to setup your software.
NSIS is script-based and allows you to create the logic to handle even the most complex installation tasks. Many plug-ins and scripts are already available: you can create web installers, communicate with Windows and other software components, install or update shared components and more.
en-US.name: Nullsoft Install System

zh-CN.description: 专业的开源 Windows 安装程序制作工具
zh-CN.longDescription:
NSIS（Nullsoft 脚本化安装系统）是一款专业的开源 Windows 安装程序制作工具。其设计追求极致的轻量化与灵活性，因此特别适合网络分发场景。
作为用户接触产品的第一环节，稳定可靠的安装程序是软件成功的关键组成部分。通过 NSIS，您能够创建满足各类软件部署需求的安装包，实现所有必要的安装功能。
NSIS 采用脚本驱动模式，支持编写逻辑代码以处理最复杂的安装任务。系统已提供大量插件与脚本资源：您可以创建网络安装程序、与 Windows 及其他软件组件交互、安装或更新共享组件等扩展功能。
